question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?
sql:
WITH monthly_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.time_id) AS month,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52779  -- France
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id) IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.time_id), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.time_id)
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month, total_sales AS sales_2019
    FROM monthly_product_sales WHERE year = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month, total_sales AS sales_2020
    FROM monthly_product_sales WHERE year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        s20.prod_id,
        s20.month,
        (((s20.sales_2020 - s19.sales_2019) / s19.sales_2019) * s20.sales_2020) + s20.sales_2020 AS projected_sales
    FROM sales_2020 s20
    JOIN sales_2019 s19 ON s20.prod_id = s19.prod_id AND s20.month = s19.month
),
projected_usd AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.month,
        p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0) AS projected_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.month
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(projected_usd) AS avg_projected_usd
    FROM projected_usd
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_projected_usd), 2) AS median_projected_sales
FROM monthly_avg
